name: Example: Holzmann lathe conversion (Marioskiv)
description: The author's machine (layout of 2026-10-04): router in the former lathe tool-post position, cutter on the chuck centreline 20 mm from the X switch; X = -20 at the switch, 0 at the centre, soft limit +113. Machining on ONE side only (X Min 0), the rigid side of the cross-slide; parts up to about 220 mm diameter. Machine Z is numbered like a mill: Z0 is the home park, 10 mm from the switch at the tailstock end, so the safe retract is machine Z 0. Aluminium: chord tolerance 0.025 mm.
